label.purpose: Uppercase panel section headers and field captions.

mono.purpose: Every numeric readout: timecodes, durations, percentages, counts.

extensions.motionNote: Flat-bench system: animate transform/opacity/width only. Ease-out, no bounce. Honor prefers-reduced-motion on progress, stage stepper, and lane updates.

breakpoints.name: app
breakpoints.purpose: Max working width for non-timeline tabs; Label Track uncaps to full width.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single loud action per panel (Run, Export, Transcribe).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #5b9dff; color: #0b1220; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #5b9dff; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 9px; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b9dff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Default secondary action; raised surface with hairline.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #232732; color: #e6e9ef; border: 1px solid #2e3340; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 9px; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #3a4150; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b9dff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Icon-only ghost (play, close, reorder). Inline SVG, never emoji.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-icon" title="Remove line"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6 6 18"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #232732; color: #e6e9ef; border: 1px solid #2e3340; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px; line-height: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-icon:hover { border-color: #3a4150; } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b9dff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The only container. Groups one logical step. Never nested.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #1c1f26; border: 1px solid #2e3340; border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; color: #e6e9ef; } .ds-panel-h { font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .6px; color: #9aa3b2; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 12px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Caption sits above; numeric inputs use mono.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-field span { font-size: 11px; color: #9aa3b2; } .ds-input { background: #232732; color: #e6e9ef; border: 1px solid #2e3340; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 9px; font: inherit; } .ds-input.ds-mono { font-family: ui-monospace, "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b9dff; outline-offset: 1px; border-color: #5b9dff; }

components.name: Conflict Chip
components.description: Read-only flag marker. Hue carries meaning (amber=overlap, red=bleed, green=done).
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 10px; } .ds-chip-overlap { background: rgba(217,164,65,.2); color: #d9a441; }

narrative.overview: WhisperMerger is a maker's workbench for audio, not a dashboard. Tools are laid out where the hand expects them, nothing is decorative, and everything is within reach. The dark tinted-charcoal surface lets waveforms, lanes, and conflict colors read like real material on the bench while the chrome stays quiet. Depth comes from tonal layering of three near-black surfaces, never from drop shadows. Numbers are first-class readouts in monospace; color is reserved for the signal-blue accent and the three conflict hues.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tinted-charcoal workbench; three tonal surfaces carry all depth (flat, no shadows).
Width belongs to the waveform — timeline surfaces run wide, not capped like a marketing page.
Monospace numerics everywhere a number is a readout.
One accent (signal blue) plus a fixed conflict palette (amber / red / green); nothing else colored.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Hue is reserved for the accent and the three conflict states. Amber=overlap, red=bleed/error, green=done/preferred. A neutral that needs to stand out gets a tonal step, not a tint.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Black Rule
rules.body: #000 and #fff are prohibited. Every neutral is tinted toward the blue hue.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Any measurement — time, duration, percent, count — is set in mono with tabular numerics, column-aligned. Never in the proportional body face.

rules.name: The Quiet Title Rule
rules.body: No oversized H1. Largest type is 17px. Hierarchy from weight, color, and tonal surface.

rules.name: The Flat-Bench Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. To stand out, raise a tonal step or add a hairline — never a shadow.

dos: Do keep color meaningful: signal blue for action/live, amber=overlap, red=bleed/error, green=done.
Do set every measurement in the mono stack with tabular numerics, column-aligned.
Do convey depth with tonal steps (base → panel → raised) and 1px hairlines. Flat by default.
Do give width to waveforms, lanes, and the transcript table.
Do keep one signal-blue primary button per panel; everything else is a ghost button.
Do carry a text label + region count alongside every speaker color swatch (colorblind-safe).
Do put an accent focus ring on every interactive control, and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't ship the generic AI/SaaS dashboard look: no decorative gradients, hero-metric cards, identical icon-card grids, or glassmorphism.
Don't look like a bloated GUI toolkit (Gradio / Streamlit / Electron / PyQt).
Don't go consumer-cute: no mascots, no emoji, no oversized friendly onboarding.
Don't build cluttered enterprise panels: no boxes inside boxes, no nested cards.
Don't use #000 or #fff; every neutral is tinted toward the blue hue.
Don't add drop shadows to convey elevation; raise a tonal step or add a hairline.
Don't use a colored side-stripe (box-shadow inset 3px, border-left > 1px) as a row accent; use a full hairline-tint or a leading chip.
Don't introduce a web/display font; it breaks the offline-instant feel.
